query: UPDATE kb_cogmap_regions r SET content_cohesion   = cogmap_region_content_cohesion(r.id), telos_alignment    = nullif(1 - (r.centroid <=> ($2::text)::vector), 'NaN'::double precision), reference_standing = cogmap_region_reference_standing(r.id), centrality         = cogmap_region_centrality(r.id), internal_tension   = cogmap_region_internal_tension(r.id, ARRAY['contradicts']) WHERE r.id=$1
